story_title: The Last Painter Who Erased Her Masterpiece

youtube_shorts.title: The Last Painter Who Erased Her Masterpiece
youtube_shorts.description:
A legendary painter shocks the world by destroying her life's work. She reveals it was an act of liberation, not madness. Her mural now lives differently in the memory of every witness.
